:::{.callout-note icon="false" collapse="false"}
## {{< fa book-bookmark >}} Further Reading

Use this callout to link to additional/external resources relevant to a given topic. This is preferable to [Quarto's footnote feature](https://quarto.org/docs/authoring/markdown-basics.html#footnotes) as this method (A) highlights the text within it and (B) emphasizes that these resources are _external_ (where a footnote could be used to relay more of our own opinions/context).
:::
